summary: Family Member Invite/Referral System testing complete. All 13 backend API tests PASSED. Frontend UI components verified working: InviteLanding page shows error for invalid codes, /login?invite=CODE opens registration with code pre-filled, 'Have an invite code?' collapsible section visible. Twilio SMS/WhatsApp notifications are MOCKED as expected.

backend_add_member_requires_phone.details: POST /api/family/add-member returns 400 when phone is missing

backend_add_member_returns_notification_.details: Response includes notifications object with mock:true (Twilio not configured)

backend_invite_info_valid_code.details: GET /api/family/invite-info/{code} returns familyName, ownerName, memberCount, inviteCode

backend_register_with_invite_code.details: POST /api/auth/register with inviteCode auto-joins family and returns familyJoined

backend_join_family_with_relationship.details: POST /api/family/join/{code} accepts relationship parameter and tracks referrals

backend_duplicate_phone_rejected.details: Adding member with duplicate phone returns 400

frontend_invite_landing_invalid_code.details: /join/:code shows 'Invalid Invite' error card with 'Go to Login' button for invalid codes

frontend_login_with_invite_opens_registr.details: /login?invite=CODE auto-opens registration form with invite code pre-filled

frontend_registration_invite_code_sectio.details: 'Have an invite code?' collapsible section visible in registration form

frontend_invite_code_prefilled.details: Invite code from URL is pre-filled in the INVITE/REFERRAL CODE input

frontend_invalid_code_warning.details: Shows 'Code not found — you can still register and join later' for invalid codes

frontend_family_page_ui.details: Family Hub page loads with Create Family Group section, Join Existing Family option visible

frontend_mpin_modal_overlay.details: SecuritySetupPrompt modal appears after registration, blocking family page interactions until dismissed

critical_code_review_comments: Backend notification_service.py correctly returns mock:true when Twilio credentials not configured
Backend invite-info endpoint is public (no auth required) as designed
Backend register endpoint correctly handles inviteCode for auto-join family
Frontend InviteLanding.js correctly handles invalid codes with error UI
Frontend RegisterForm.js correctly pre-fills invite code from URL and shows validation
Frontend Login.js correctly detects invite param and opens registration mode
